title: Paper Voyager · A paper trip around the world
desc: A game for iPhone and Android: run through 72 real cities made of cut paper, with 8 travelers and their stories.
hero.lead: A paper trip around the world. Run through real cities cut by hand, snap selfies and uncover every traveler’s story.
game.h: Build your way, city by city
game.p: Paper Voyager is a lane runner: dodge obstacles, collect coins and reach the airport to fly to your next destination. Everything is crafted like a cut-paper storybook.
f1.p: From Osaka to Angel Falls, across 46 countries. Every city has its landmarks, weather and obstacles.
f2.p: Each one travels for a reason. Follow their postcards and unlock their secret outfit.
f3.p: Selfies in every city, souvenirs, passports for each region and an album to decorate.
f4.p: A trip takes a couple of minutes, perfect for the bus. In 8 languages.
cast.p: Eight travelers from eight corners of the world, each with a motto, a story and outfits.
shots.h: A paper world in your pocket
final.p: Try it now in your browser. Coming soon to iPhone and Android.
